description: This file defines internal static class MessagingProcessingInstruments responsible for metrics instrumentation in Orleans runtime. It includes counters and observables for message processing, receiving, forwarding, and enqueuing statistics, as well as methods to update these metrics based on message events.

classes.name: MessagingProcessingInstruments
classes.description: A static class organizing metrics instruments for messaging processing within Orleans runtime.

methods.name: OnDispatcherMessageReceive
methods.description: Updates message received counters based on the message's direction and runtime context.

methods.name: OnDispatcherMessageProcessedOk
methods.description: Increments counters for messages processed successfully, grouped by message direction.

methods.name: OnDispatcherMessageProcessedError
methods.description: Increments counters for messages processed with errors, grouped by message direction.

methods.name: OnImaMessageReceived
methods.description: Updates the counter for received IMA messages.

methods.name: OnImaMessageEnqueued
methods.description: Updates the counter for enqueued IMA messages, categorized by context type (null, system target, grain).

methods.name: RegisterActivationDataAllObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge to monitor activation data across the messaging system.
